name: What needs to be done before basement wall framing starts?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before basement wall framing starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing can begin, complete all exterior moisture mitigation, test for radon, and finish any foundation crack repairs. If your basement shows signs of efflorescence, seepage, or wet floor seams, those water sources must be fixed permanently first. You must also plan your final floor layout, including marking rough locations for plumbing fixtures, HVAC vents, and electrical panels. Clearing the entire perimeter of stored items and ensuring existing utility shutoffs remain accessible are vital preparation steps before contractors set baseline chalk lines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fix all moisture issues and foundation cracks, finalize your floor plan, clear the perimeter, and confirm utility access before marking chalk lines and setting studs.
